title: Distinct cellular source and bulk immune correlates of HAVCR2 expression in seminoma.
snippet: HAVCR2 (T-cell immunoglobulin and mucin domain-containing protein 3; TIM-3) expression is associated with favorable prognosis in seminoma, but its underlying immune context remains unclear.
